intro: Aha Anandame is the Christian Telugu Christmas song released in the year 2009 written & tuned by Mary Vijay Nanneti, sung by Telugu Christian Gospel Singer Lillian Christopher and music composed by renowned Telugu christian music director, J K Christopher. This song video was released on December 09, 2020 through Sharon Sisters YouTube Channel.
